page_title: SAS 0-1 MON | Sassuolo v Monza 02/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Luca Zufferli is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save.
90+4' A pass by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

90+2' A nice pass finds Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the right side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
90+1' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' The goal by Monza won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
88' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Monza players aren’t happy.

86' A great individual effort by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza)! Showcasing his skills, he found his way deep inside the box and produced a low shot which goes into the bottom left corner. A quite a remarkable goal!

85' The most active player in today's match is definitely Patrick Ciurria (Monza). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
84' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:8.
82' The substitution is prepared. Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matheus Henrique.
81' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Michele Di Gregorio.

79' That's a well-taken pass by Samuele Birindelli (Monza). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
78' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
75' Substitution. Papu Gomez (Monza) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Georgios Kyriakopoulos walks off.
74' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
71' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Samuele Birindelli (Monza) replaces Andrea Colpani.
71' A substitution has been made. Dany Mota goes off and Samuele Vignato (Monza) comes on.
70' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.
70' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes a short corner kick.
68' Ruan Tressoldi is substituted due to injury. Alessio Dionisi gives a chance to Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo).

66' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 0:1. Andrea Consigli was helpless.
65' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
64' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
63' The resulting corner from Dany Mota (Monza) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
60' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
60' It will be a substitution. Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) is ready to enter the pitch as Matias Vina walks off.
60' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
57' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Andrea Consigli to make a comfortable save.
56' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
54' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
53' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Matteo Pessina and he is replaced by Jose Machin (Monza).
53' Andrea Carboni goes off the pitch and Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) comes on.
52' A pass from Andrea Colpani (Monza) is intercepted by Andrea Consigli and the move breaks down.
51' Monza are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
50' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

48' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Dany Mota (Monza) who sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
48' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored!
46' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Kristian Thorstvedt comes off for Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Monza will take a free kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
43' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
42' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
40' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle. Andrea Colpani (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Sassuolo.
40' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
39' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
37' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it. Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
37' A corner kick by Sassuolo is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Monza).

36' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the top left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Michele Di Gregorio. Sassuolo have a corner.
36' A spell of possession for Monza in an attempt to control the game.
34' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) plays a through ball but overhits it.
32' One of the players from Monza times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
31' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
30' A cross by Patrick Ciurria (Monza) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
28' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
27' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Monza in a dangerous position.
26' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
24' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
23' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) but poses no threat.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 56:44.
20' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

19' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Corner kick. Sassuolo will have an opportunity.
19' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It's a throw-in for Sassuolo.
17' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
17' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

16' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
16' A crossfield pass from Pablo Mari (Monza) fails to find any of his teammates.
15' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
13' Andrea Colpani (Monza) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.
12' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) is flagged for offside.
10' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

9' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Andrea Consigli. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
7' Sassuolo get a corner.

7' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a chance to score from a corner.
6' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
5' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Sassuolo.
3' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
2' Monza are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

Sassuolo will kick the game off.
